dct_description_sm: This dataset contains records of insects, mostly pollinators, across UBC Botanical Garden from surveys conducted from April  to July of 2025. Insects were collected, identified, pinned and labeled by either Elizabeth Elle (SFU), Grace Gooding (UBC Botanical Garden), and Tiia Haapalainen (SFU). Data archiving was conducted by Adriana Lopez-Villalobos, Grace Gooding and Mina Lander (UBC Botanical Garden). This dataset supports ecological research and habitat monitoring, specifically pollinator diversity and abundance.
dct_title_s: UBC Botanical Garden Pollinator Surveys Summer 2025 (April-July)
